newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted at flat to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted at flat to lower.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels on Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus four barges on Thursday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff, unchanged from Thursday, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, no comparison, offer 107-1/2 percent.
- One barge, St Louis, Mississippi River, Lifttop, on station, no bid, no comparison, offer 90 percent.
- One barge, Cairo, Mississippi River, $500 switched, on station, no bid, no comparison, offer 90 percent.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of September, bid 152-1/2 percent, down 2-1/2 percent from Thursday, offer 160 percent.
